title: crash cheats at tic tac toe
pitch: beat crash at tic tac toe. he deletes your x's, fakes lag, spills coffee and blue-screens when he's losing. good luck.
controls: tap / click a square · keys 1–9 or arrows + space · q firewall, w ctrl+z, e report (costs a token)
